contentEn:
Richmond homeowners spend between $12,000 and $45,000 on a bathroom renovation in 2026, depending on scope, materials and whether the project involves plumbing reconfiguration. Based on 8 completed Richmond bathroom projects in the Reno Stars portfolio, here is what real budgets look like across three tiers.

What Affects Your Richmond Bathroom Renovation Cost

The single largest variable is whether the bathroom layout changes. Moving a toilet, shower or vanity requires re-piping the drain lines—a structural plumbing job that typically adds $3,000–$8,000 to the project compared to a like-for-like replacement. A second major factor is flooring: removing existing tile and installing new porcelain or natural stone runs $1,200–$3,500 in a standard 50-square-foot bathroom.

Vanity selection also drives cost significantly. A stock 36-inch single-sink vanity from a home centre costs $300–$800 installed. A custom 72-inch double-sink vanity with stone countertop typically runs $4,000–$9,000 including installation. The tradeoff is real: a mid-range custom vanity alone can exceed the total budget of a basic refresh renovation.

Richmond Bathroom Renovation Cost by Tier

Mid-Range Renovation$18,000 – $32,000Walk-in shower, custom vanity, porcelain tile, new lighting, exhaust fan3–5 weeks
Premium / Primary Bath$32,000 – $45,000+Double vanity, curbless shower, heated floors, freestanding tub, designer fixtures5–8 weeks

Real Richmond Project Budgets (2025–2026)

These are actual completed-project budgets from Richmond bathrooms Reno Stars finished between 2025 and 2026:

  • Daughter's Bath with Gray Tiles — 55 sq ft, walk-in shower, custom gray tile, new vanity and toilet. Complete budget withheld at homeowner request.
  • Dual Bathroom + Powder Room — Full renovation of two full bathrooms plus powder room in the same home, combining layout changes with premium finishes. This project demonstrates the cost efficiency of doing multiple bathrooms in one renovation phase.
  • White Shaker Cabinet Bathroom — Standard-layout bathroom with custom white shaker cabinets, quartz countertop and premium shower glass. Representative of the mid-range tier at approximately $22,000.
  • Two-Bathroom Modern Finish — Two full bathrooms renovated simultaneously in a Richmond home, modern finishes throughout. Dual-bathroom projects typically cost 70–85% of what two separate single-bathroom renovations would, due to shared tradeMobilization and reduced setup overhead.

Permits and Regulations for Richmond Bathroom Renovations

Most cosmetic and surface-level bathroom renovations in Richmond do not require a building permit. A permit becomes required when the scope involves:

  • Moving or adding plumbing fixtures (adding a second bathroom where none existed)
  • Structural changes to walls or floor systems
  • Electrical panel upgrades to support heated floors or steam systems

Richmond follows the BC Building Code 2024, which mandates that all bathroom exhaust fans vent directly to the exterior—no inline fans discharging into attics. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of the project management fee for affected renovations.

Why Richmond Bathroom Projects Cost What They Do

Richmond's geography contributes to renovation costs in ways that are easy to overlook. Many Richmond homes sit on relatively new construction fill soil, which can affect floor joist deflection in upper floors. A bathroom on a second floor with tile flooring may require floor reinforcement before the tile installation—adding $800–$2,500 depending on the structural assessment.

Strata approval is another Richmond-specific cost factor. If your home is in a townhouse or apartment complex, your renovation may require strata approval before work begins. Reno Stars has managed strata approval processes for bathroom renovations in Richmond's Riverside, Britannia Gardens and Mayflower Park neighbourhoods, typically adding 2–4 weeks to project timelines for the approval process alone.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Richmond?

From demolition to final inspection, a standard Richmond bathroom renovation runs 3–5 weeks for mid-range projects. Premium primary bathroom renovations involving layout changes can extend to 6–8 weeks. All plumbing work requires a City of Richmond inspection, which Reno Stars schedules and passes as part of the standard project scope.

How to Budget for Your Richmond Bathroom Renovation

Start with a realistic assessment of your goals. A basic refresh protects your home's value with minimal disruption. A mid-range renovation typically recovers 60–70% of its cost in increased property value for Richmond homes. A premium primary bathroom renovation is primarily a lifestyle investment—your home's resale value benefit is meaningful but rarely covers the full premium upgrade cost.

Always request a detailed line-item quote that separates trade costs (plumbing, electrical, tiling), material costs and project management fees. Reno Stars provides this breakdown in every initial consultation.

How much does a basic bathroom renovation cost in Richmond?

A basic bathroom refresh in Richmond—new toilet, vanity, bathtub refinish, flooring and paint—costs between $12,000 and $18,000 in 2026. This tier assumes no plumbing reconfiguration and uses mid-range fixtures rather than custom cabinetry or premium tile.

What is the average cost of a mid-range bathroom renovation in Richmond?

A mid-range bathroom renovation in Richmond, including a walk-in shower, custom vanity, porcelain tile flooring, upgraded lighting and a new exhaust fan, costs between $18,000 and $32,000. Most Richmond primary bathroom renovations fall into this range.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Richmond?

Cosmetic renovations—refinishing surfaces, replacing fixtures in the same locations, updating lighting—do not require a permit in Richmond. A permit is required when moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural elements, or upgrading electrical panels. Reno Stars manages the permit process for all applicable projects.

How long does a full bathroom renovation take in Richmond?

A standard full bathroom renovation in Richmond takes 3–5 weeks for mid-range projects and 5–8 weeks for premium primary bathroom renovations with layout changes. All projects requiring plumbing work must pass a City of Richmond inspection before completion.

Does a bathroom renovation add value to my Richmond home?

Yes. A mid-range bathroom renovation in Richmond typically recovers 60–70% of its cost in added property value. In Richmond's competitive real estate market, an updated bathroom is among the highest-ROI improvements before listing. Premium renovations are primarily lifestyle investments with more modest direct value recovery.
contentZh:
列治文業主在2026年進行浴室翻新，費用普遍在 $12,000 至 $45,000 之間，具體取決於工程範圍、材料選擇及是否涉及管道重新配置。根據聚星裝修已完成之8個列治文浴室工程項目，以下為三個不同層級之真實預算。

影響列治文浴室翻新費用的因素

最大變數是浴室佈局是否變動。移動馬桶、淋浴間或洗手台的排水管道屬於結構性管道工程，相比原位替換通常需額外花費 $3,000 至 $8,000。第二大因素是地板：拆除舊瓷磚並鋪設新瓷磚或天然石材，在50平方英尺的標準浴室中通常需 $1,200 至 $3,500。

洗手台選擇對費用影響顯著。標準36英寸單盆洗手台（家裝店購買）含安裝費用約 $300–$800。定製72英寸雙盆洗手台配石材台面，含安裝通常為 $4,000 至 $9,000。實際取捨很清晰：中檔定製洗手台的價格可超過基本翻新工程的總預算。

列治文浴室翻新費用分層參考

翻新層級2026年費用範圍含項目工期
基本翻新$12,000 – $18,000新馬桶、洗手台、浴缸翻新、地板、牆面漆、衛浴配件2–3週
中檔翻新$18,000 – $32,000步入式淋浴間、定製洗手台、瓷磚地板、新照明、排氣扇3–5週
豪華/主浴室$32,000 – $45,000+雙洗手台、無障礙淋浴間、地暖、獨立浴缸、設計師衛浴配件5–8週

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即獲取聚星裝修的免費、無義務報價。

列治文真實工程預算（2025–2026）

以下為聚星裝修於2025至2026年間在列治文完成之實際浴室工程預算：

  • 女兒浴室（灰瓷磚） — 55平方英尺，步入式淋浴間，訂製灰瓷磚，新洗手台及馬桶。業主要求不公開完整預算。
  • 雙浴室＋化妝間 — 同時翻新兩間完整浴室及化妝間，含佈局改動及豪華飾面。工程顯示一次性翻新多間浴室的成本效益。
  • 白色鄉村風浴室櫃 — 標準佈局浴室，配訂製白色鄉村風櫥櫃、石英石台面及優質淋浴玻璃。為中檔層級代表項目，造價約 $22,000。
  • 兩浴室現代翻新 — 列治文住宅兩間完整浴室同步翻新，全程採用現代飾面。兩浴室同時翻新工程造價約為兩次單獨翻新之70–85%，因為節省了重複調動工匠及設置費用。

列治文浴室翻新的許可證與法規

列治文大多數美容性及表面翻新工程無需申請建築許可證。以下範圍則需要許可證：

  • 移動或新增管道裝置（於原本沒有浴室的位置新增浴室）
  • 牆體或地板結構改動
  • 為安裝地暖或蒸汽系統而升級電箱

列治文採用2024年卑詩省建築規範，規定所有浴室排氣扇必須直接排出屋外，而非排放至閣樓。聚星裝修負責處理受影響工程的許可證申請，相關費用已包含於工程管理費中。

列治文浴室翻新費用的特殊原因

列治文的地質條件對翻新費用有不易察覺的影響。許多列治文住宅建於相對較新的填土層上，這可能影響二樓浴室的地板托梁彎曲度。鋪設瓷磚的二樓浴室可能需要先進行地板加固，費用為 $800 至 $2,500，具體取決於結構評估結果。

共管公寓批准是另一個列治文特有的成本因素。若您的住宅屬於城市屋或公寓小區，翻新工程可能需要在開工前獲得小區管理處批准。聚星裝修曾在Riverside、Britannia Gardens及Mayflower Park等列治文小區代為處理浴室翻新工程的小區審批流程，通常需額外2至4週。

列治文基本浴室翻新多少錢？

列治文基本浴室翻新——新馬桶、洗手台、浴缸翻新、地板及牆面漆——2026年費用為 $12,000 至 $18,000。此層級假設不涉及管道重新配置，並使用中檔衛浴配件而非定製櫥櫃或豪華瓷磚。

列治文中檔浴室翻新平均費用是多少？

含步入式淋浴間、定製洗手台、瓷磚地板、升級照明及新排氣扇的列治文中檔浴室翻新，費用為 $18,000 至 $32,000。大多數列治文主浴室翻新均屬此層級。

列治文浴室翻新需要許可證嗎？

美容性翻新——表面翻新、原位更換裝置、更新照明——在列治文無需許可證。移動管道裝置、改動結構元素或升級電箱則需要許可證。聚星裝修為所有適用工程代辦許可證流程。

列治文完整浴室翻新需要多長時間？

含水電的中檔列治文浴室翻新工程需時3至5週。涉及佈局改動的豪華主浴室翻新則需5至8週。所有涉及管道工程的項目必須通過列治文市政府驗收後方可完工。

浴室翻新能為我的列治文住宅增值嗎？

能。列治文中檔浴室翻新通常可收回成本之60%至70%的房產增值。在列治文競爭激烈的房地產市場中，翻新浴室是掛牌前最高投資回報的改善工程之一。豪華翻新主要為生活品質投資，直接房產增值回報較為有限。
